title: A daily report with a button to the list
summary: Every day at a time you choose, how many rows your table had today and their total, with a button that opens today's list.
description: Two parts, installed together. Every day at the time you choose, the people with the role you choose hear how many rows were added to your table today and the total of its amount column, with a See the list button. The button opens a tool, also used from the chat on the web, the phone app, WhatsApp, Telegram and Slack by its word ("/sales-today"), that lists today's rows. Choose the word it is called by when you install it; if that word is taken, it gets the next free one (sales-today-2) and says so.

params.name: command
params.title: Its word
params.description: What people type to see today's list, after /. Letters, numbers and dashes.

params.name: title_column
params.title: Each row shows
params.description: The column each row of the list is named by.

params.name: amount_column
params.title: Adds up
params.description: The column of amounts it adds up.

params.name: send_time
params.title: Time
params.description: When the report is sent each day, Lagos time.

params.name: role
params.title: Who hears it
params.description: The role whose members get the report.

definition.name: Today's list
definition.description: Lists the rows added to a table today.

outputs.name: rows
outputs.title: Today
outputs.value: =steps.today.output.rows.map(r, {'title': {{title_column}} in r ? string(r[{{title_column}}]) : '', 'amount': {{amount_column}} in r ? string(r[{{amount_column}}]) : ''})

tool.name: Today's list
tool.about: The rows added to your table today

definition.name: Daily report
definition.description: Every day, counts and adds up today's rows and tells the team, with a button to the list.

steps.name: Tell the team today's count and total

input.title: Today
input.message: =string(size(steps.today.output.rows)) + ' today, ' + string(sum(steps.today.output.rows.map(r, {{amount_column}} in r ? double(r[{{amount_column}}]) : 0.0))) + ' in all.'
